reason: Single-file fix in one service (Identity.API AccountController POST Login).

items.goal: In AccountController POST Login, when sign-in succeeds, there is no authorization context and ReturnUrl is non-empty and not local, log a warning (without writing the raw URL unsanitized) and return Redirect("~/") instead of throwing, so the user is signed in and lands on Identity.API's home page and the external URL is never followed.
items.modelReason: Mechanical replacement of one throw with a log and redirect plus a logger injection.
items.verifyReason: Backend-only controller change; no UI files touched.

alternatives.reason: Open redirect; the Expected result forbids following it.

alternatives.option: Return the login view with a model error
alternatives.reason: Expected says the user is signed in and lands on the home page.
